components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e4e4e7; }

narrative.overview: Sparstrowgen's UI is designed as a quiet, hyper-focused, and technically precise environment for software engineers and AI developers. The visual language prioritizes high information density, crystal-clear typography, and fast keyboard-first navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet Elevation: Flat-by-default cards with 1px border contrast.
Typography-Driven Hierarchy: Scale and weight contrast.
Restrained Accent Strategy: Purposeful accent highlights.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors appear on <=10% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Line-Length Rule
rules.body: Body text capped at 65-75ch per line.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rely on 1px border contrast instead of heavy drop shadows.

dos: Do use @sparstrow/ui Shadcn UI primitives across all routes.
Do use OKLCH semantic tokens (bg-background, bg-card, border-border).
donts: Don't use hardcoded Tailwind slate/cyan colors.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders as decorative card accents.
Don't use gradient text or glassmorphism blurs.
